candidates.reason: Hadley v Baxendale (J34) sets the foundational rules on remoteness and recoverability of lost profits. Victoria Laundry (J35) refines recoverability based on the defendant's knowledge of special circumstances. Spartan Steel (J21) distinguishes between recoverable consequential economic loss and non-recoverable pure economic loss. These cases together provide the lawyer with key tests and distinctions applicable for the bakery's lost profits and one-off wedding contract losses.
